feedback: Judged from iterations 0 to 2 and the candidate's own contents, not from any race of this candidate. Iteration 1 (sensor x = -0.04..+0.04, sensor_size 0.012, kp 3.0, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.4) is the best raced design at 154.1. Line loss stayed at 0.95 to 1.00 per run on every track, and every run ended off_track except one oval finish. Iteration 2 raised kp to 3.5 with no reduction in line loss, and the score fell to 125.8, so kp is not the lever for line loss. Steering oscillation was 0.11 to 0.30, so the controller is under-correcting, not unstable. Oval finish time of 1.93 s in iteration 1 shows base_speed 1.4 is fast enough, so speed is not the limit. This candidate is iteration 1 with one variable changed: sensor_size 0.012 to 0.016. Its block matches that stated change, with kp 3.0 and sensor geometry otherwise identical to iteration 1. It is valid against the contract. The hypothesis is that a 16 mm footprint keeps some tape under a sensor through bends. Racing is the only way to test it. Next-step rules after the race: (a) if line_loss_events falls to about 0.5 or below per run and progress rises on the s-bend and slalom, keep sensor_size 0.016 and test kd 0.3 to 0.4, since oscillation was 0.11 to 0.30; (b) if line loss stays near 1.0, return to sensor_size 0.012 and try a narrower spread (x = -0.03..+0.03); (c) if oscillation rises well above 0.3 on the oval, lower kd before changing anything else. Approve now because it is a clean single-variable test with budget for one revision afterwards, and the telemetry will sharpen the next review.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events is at or below about 0.5 per run and progress rises on the s-bend and slalom, keep geometry.sensor_size 0.016 and try controller.kd at 0.3 to 0.4 (oscillation was 0.11 to 0.30 in iterations 0 to 2).

If line_loss_events stays near 1.0 per run on every track, return geometry.sensor_size to 0.012 and narrow the spread to sensor x = -0.03, -0.015, 0.0, 0.015, 0.03 (iteration 1 showed line loss is not reduced by kp alone).

If steering_oscillation rises well above 0.3 on the oval, lower controller.kd (for example 0.5 to 0.3) before changing kp or base_speed, because iteration 2 showed raising kp to 3.5 worsened the score.
